name: Coconut Flour
siboNotes: Well-tolerated for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and high in fiber, though the fiber content may cause digestive symptoms if consumed in large amounts initially.
preparationTips: Use only 1/4 the amount compared to wheat flour in recipes due to high absorbency
Always sift before measuring to break up clumps
Add extra liquid or eggs to recipes as coconut flour absorbs moisture rapidly
Allow batter to rest 5-10 minutes before baking to fully hydrate
